question: Minati Mishra was conferred the Padma Shree for her contribution to which form of dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Minati Mishra was a renowned Indian classical dancer known for her contributions to the Odissi dance form.
 
• She was conferred the Padma Shree, one of India's highest civilian awards, in 2012 for her significant contributions to Odissi.
 
• Odissi is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• Minati Mishra was not only a performer but also a teacher and choreographer, contributing immensely to the promotion and preservation of Odissi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi Dance**:

 
 
• Odissi is characterized by its intricate footwork, expressive gestures, and sculpturesque poses.
 
• It is traditionally performed by women, and its themes are usually religious, often inspired by the Vaishnavism sect.
 
• Odissi is known for its Tribhangi posture, which divides the body into three parts: head, bust, and torso.
 
• The dance form includes both pure dance (Nritta) and expressive dance (Abhinaya).
 
 
 
• **Padma Shree Award**:
 
 
• The Padma Shree is the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded to citizens of India in recognition of their distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity, including the arts.
 
• The award is announced on Republic Day (26th January) each year.
 
 
 
• **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra**:
 
 
• He is considered one of the foremost exponents of Odissi dance.
 
• His contributions have been instrumental in reviving and popularizing the dance form in modern times.
 
 
 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India**:
 
 
• India is home to several classical dance forms, each with its unique style and cultural significance.
 
• Other major classical dance forms include Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
